translations.source: You can change the Interpolation Mode of the curve points in the right-click menu.
translations.target: 可以在右键菜单中更改曲线点的 Interpolation Mode（插值模式）。

translations.source: Note that you can mix different interpolation modes on different curve points.
translations.target: 注意，可以在不同曲线点上混用不同插值模式。

translations.source: The interpolation mode of the first (or left) curve point will be used between two curve points with different interpolation modes.
translations.target: 当两个曲线点使用不同插值模式时，将使用第一个（或左侧）曲线点的插值模式来计算它们之间的变化。

translations.source: and dragging the dots at the end of the bézier handles. A flat part of the curve means the values change slowly and a steep part of the curve means the values change quickly.
translations.target: 并拖动 Bézier 手柄末端的点来调整插值。曲线平缓的部分表示数值变化较慢，曲线陡峭的部分表示数值变化较快。

translations.source: will generate a smooth line from one curve point to another. This avoids having hard transitions.
translations.target: 会在一个曲线点到另一个曲线点之间生成平滑曲线，避免生硬过渡。

translations.source: Values move linearly from one curve point to another. This is useful for getting very predictable results, but can result in robotic looking transitions.
translations.target: 数值会从一个曲线点线性移动到另一个曲线点。这有助于获得非常可预测的结果，但也可能产生机械感较强的过渡。

translations.source: Values stay constant until the next curve point is reached. This results in jumping values.
translations.target: 数值会保持恒定，直到到达下一个曲线点。因此数值会出现跳变。

translations.source: The handles can be moved freely and can have any direction and length. For this type, one handle is always in the inverted direction and has the same length as the other one.
translations.target: 手柄可以自由移动，方向和长度都不受限制。对于此类型，一个手柄始终位于另一个手柄的反方向，并且长度相同。

translations.source: The handles can be moved in any way separate from each other.
translations.target: 两侧手柄可以彼此独立地任意移动。

translations.source: This is the default behavior. For this type, the handles can never go beyond the previous or next curve point. Note that when changing the handles the type will be set to Aligned.

translations.source: This will point the left handle towards the previous curve point and the right handle towards the next curve point. Note that when changing the handles the type will be set to Free.
